title: Implement deterministic inert Profile discovery
goal: Expose schema-valid snapshot-bound discovery facts without executing or mutating the Target.
acceptanceCriteria: profile discover returns deterministic allowlisted facts with source detector and Target snapshot bindings.
Installed Module inventory and declared prerequisites are reported from validated PackageRoot authority.
Unknown and ambiguous inputs remain explicit and no Target build restore download execution or write is possible.
Focused positive and negative discovery tests pass and Target bytes remain unchanged.
risks: Recursive discovery could cross a link or accidentally inspect executable or oversized content.
decisions: Use a closed inert file-name/extension allowlist and content-derived deterministic snapshots.
